```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml'
      - 'AGENTS.md'

jobs:
  setup-copilot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'
      
      - name: Install pre-commit
        run: |
          pip install pre-commit
      
      - name: Run pre-commit on all files
        id: pre_commit
        run: |
          pre-commit run --all-files
        continue-on-error: true
      
      - name: Cancel previous runs
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && steps.pre_commit.outcome == 'failure' }}
        with:
          workflow_id: Copilot Setup Steps
          ignore_sha: true
      
      - name: Commit changes if pre-commit failed
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@04702edda442b2e678b25b537cec683a1493fcb9
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && steps.pre_commit.outcome == 'failure' }}
        with:
          commit_message: "chore: run pre-commit on all files"
          branch: ${{ github.ref }}
          add_options: '-A'
          commit_user_name: 'GitHub Actions'
          commit_user_email: 'actions@github.com'
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up the necessary steps to run `pre-commit run --all-files` as part of the pre-commit workflow. It includes steps to check out the code, set up Python, install pre-commit, run pre-commit on all files, cancel previous runs if pre-commit fails, and automatically commit changes if pre-commit fails. The workflow only runs when the specified files (`copilot-setup-steps.yml` and `AGENTS.md`) are changed in a pull request.
